title: Challenge 5 Quiz - Legal, Compliance and Ownership Structures

questions.question: What does legal ownership mean?
options: Official ownership of an asset recognized under applicable law

questions.question: In most RWA projects, token ownership represents:
options: Automatic legal ownership of the physical asset
Rights defined by the project's legal agreements

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Know Your Customer (KYC)?
options: To verify the identity of customers

questions.question: What is the main objective of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations?
options: To prevent financial crimes such as money laundering

questions.question: What is a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)?
options: A separate legal entity created for a specific purpose

questions.question: What is the role of an asset custodian?
options: To safeguard assets and important legal documents

questions.question: Why are independent audits valuable in RWA projects?
options: They help verify assets, records and compliance

questions.question: What does jurisdiction determine?
options: Which laws and regulations apply to a project

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a compliance risk?
Why is compliance important in Real-World Asset projects?
options: It helps protect investors, businesses and the integrity of the financial system
It guarantees every project will succeed
